title: Goto
body:
Syntax: goto <vnum>  |  goto <player name>

Description: (Staff only.) Teleports you directly to a room by vnum, or to wherever an online player currently is. Bypasses any locked/private room restrictions, same as staff already can when walking normally. Going to a vnum with no room there yet creates one on the spot (a bare 'An Unfinished Room', same placeholder 'rset bexit' uses) and teleports you there.

'rset goto <vnum>' does the same teleport, then leaves you there editing that room with rset -- see 'help rset'.

Date: 2026-08-28
